d:
Priy vyuars,
Har vishisht divas is bat ka ek avsar bhi hota hai ki ham us nihitarth ko samjhen ki har varsh ham ise kyon yad karte hain? ham samjhen ki aakhir vo kin tattvon ko khojne ki kavayad hai, kin mulyon ko sanjone ki koshish hai jinke liye ham varshik yad ki yah rasm nibhate hain. aur jab bat 'gantantr divas' ki ho tab to is disha men vichar karna aur zaruri ho jata hai.
